name: dmengine-fumo-download-multi
description: Mode C FUMO multi-component download: the mock serves a 291-byte object whose DP body has two components (LABCOMP/LABID and LABCOMP2/LABID2) and three 16-byte update payloads, followed by the 52-byte lab HMAC trailer. The engine performs the authenticated DD/object GET, posts the install notification and advances FUMO state 30 -> 40. The package is a structural lab fixture; no install is claimed.
